invariants.rationale: Context is expected to be a valid engine context for method execution, so it should not be null at entry.
instantTime typically represents a required timestamp or commit instant and is expected to be non-null and non-empty.
A list of prepped records to insert is required; a null value would generally be invalid.
Even if the Option may be empty, it should not itself be null according to method contract.
If the list of records is non-empty, its first element should not be null, indicating properly constructed records.
